text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 18.0 to 18.8 s side view: a white car in a brown flooded street drifts slightly right while the water climbs from the hubs to cover the wheels and lower doors; reflection beneath. House, tree and street sign behind. Caption box sits directly below the car over the water edge.
